status: Specified before development and held-out evaluation
worlds: b sign switches at t=30, d=0
descriptive timing control: sign switch at t=32

stages.matched: Every policy receives and pays for all 12 reference packets, including policies that ignore them. This isolates use of identical acquisition access.
stages.adaptive: Each policy may acquire at most 6 packets under a common .12 sensing cap; ordinary observations remain free. No side-channel access to declined observations. Policy variance heuristic, not optimal sensing.

loss: sum t=0..59 of x_next^2 + .05 u_t^2 + .02 per reference acquisition + .0001 per weighted model work unit
work_model: Named numerical/model blocks with disclosed weights, not measured FLOPs, human effort, wall-time price, or actual energy. Control and forecast overhead included. Loop/allocation overhead and transient arrays excluded. Report hardware timing separately, not as a psychological result.
latency: No physical latency imposed; all policy computations finish within the modeled step. Only weighted work expense is tested.
randomness: One NumPy default_rng per seed; x0,b0 and all 60 eps,eta,w draws generated before policy execution. Same exogenous draws across policies and worlds; actual observations vary with actions.
parameter_selection: Minimize mean total loss over both stages and four primary worlds on development only. Do not use timing control for tuning.
baseline_selection: Select globally across four development worlds, separately per stage, from raw,direct,joint_y_only. No true world label supplied to any policy.
primary_test: retained minus dev-selected baseline for each of four worlds and two stages. Paired mean differences across 1000 seed clusters; normal approximate two-sided familywise 95% intervals over 8 tests via Bonferroni. Improvement requires upper bound below -.02. Other contrasts and switch32 descriptive 95% intervals.
forecast: Before action effect, record Normal(.8*xhat+u, .64*state_error_variance+.0025) approximation and P(abs(x_next)>.5), score realized action-conditioned next state. Gaussian/moment assumptions may fail, especially adaptive gains and discrete or shifted bias.
recovery: Only |b0|=1 in switch worlds. First completed window of 5 consecutive |x_next|<=.2; confirmed delay j+5 from switch. Censor non-recovery at remaining horizon and report recovery fraction separately. This is transient recovery, not a guarantee of permanent stability.
memory_accounting: Required persistent belief scalars reported analytically; not measured peak process memory. Runtime covers full simulator execution, not isolated policy deliberation.
negative_controls: nested and flat retained bias estimator must match every trace exactly
4 repeated identical estimate computations must preserve behavior while adding work cost
joint filter using only ordinary observations
scope: Synthetic selected models, not empirical psychology, consciousness, unique hierarchy identification, or ethical legitimacy. Dynamics and objectives supplied and known to relevant algorithms. No unanticipated purpose revision implemented.
